title: My Stepmom's Daughter Is My Ex Light Novel Series Ends With 14th Volume
content: Kamishiro began serializing the story on the Kakuyomu website in August 2017. Kadokawa began publishing the story in print volumes with illustrations by Takayaki ( Arifureta - From Commonplace to World's Strongest ) in December 2018. The 13th volume shipped in October 2025.
author: ANN

title: Light Novel 'Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta' Ends with 14th Volume
content: The official X account for Kyousuke Kamishiro and TakayaKi 's Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta ( My Stepmom's Daughter Is My Ex ) series announced on Wednesday that the light novel series will end with its 14th volume. The final volume is scheduled to release on December 1.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Major Crunchyroll Isekai Creator Breaks Silence on Heartbreaking Episode Ahead of Finale
content: A major Isekai anime now streaming with Crunchyroll really broke hearts with some major events ahead of its finale for the year, and the creator behind it all has revealed their reaction to everything that went down.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru' Gets Third Season
content: • The 12th and final episode of Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru II ( From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman Season 2 ) ended with an announcement on Thursday that a third season is in production. The official website also revealed an announcement visual (pictured).
author: MyAnimeList

title: hololive VTuber Agency's 1st TV Anime Project Reveals Title, Visual, Cast, Staff
content: Kadokawa and COVER Corporation announced during a special livestream on Wednesday that the first television anime project for Cover's hololive VTuber agency is titled hololive: Let's Head Out! in English.
author: ANN

title: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure Debuts New Opening Ahead of Steel Ball Run Return – Watch Now
content: JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure is set to kick off the new slate of Fall 2026 anime releases with the return of Steel Ball Run , and the anime has dropped its new opening theme sequence early ahead of its big comeback.
author: ComicBook

title: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman Season 3 Announced
content: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman Season 3 anime was officially announced immediately after the second season ended. The second season of the anime was announced immediately after the first one, and it premiered on July 8.
author: Anime Corner

title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Opening Video Released, Theme Song by Kroi
content: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure revealed the opening video and song ahead of the 2ND and 3RD STAGE premiere on September 25 . The anime previously confirmed 11 episodes for stages 2 and 3, along with weekly streaming on Netflix.
author: Anime Corner

title: Bleach’s Final Season to Officially Reveal Ichigo’s Son Ahead of Anime Finale
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War is now in the works on its final two episodes ever, and the anime is going to reveal the voice behind Ichigo Kurosaki’s son ahead of the anime’s grand finale.
